name_zh: 奥尔特加/尼加拉瓜/桑地诺/革命/选举/独裁/丹尼尔/罗莎里奥/循环
core_mode: M608 革命独裁/选举循环/桑地诺异化/罗莎里奥/家族统治
description_zh: 丹尼尔·奥尔特加（1952-至今），尼加拉瓜前总统，1985-1990年在位。他是一位尼加拉瓜政治家，前战士，通过领导桑地诺革命推翻了美国支持的索摩扎政权。奥尔特加是桑地诺革命的领导者之一，领导了尼加拉瓜的解放斗争。他在领导革命中，提出了"革命独裁"理论，体现了桑地诺异化现象。他的统治时期，尼加拉瓜实现了从独裁到革命的过渡，但也面临了美国的持续干预和国内政治循环。
description_en: Daniel Ortega (1952-present), former President of Nicaragua, served from 1985 to 1990. He was a Nicaraguan politician and former guerrilla fighter, led Sandinista Revolution to overthrow US-backed Somoza dictatorship. Ortega was one of the leaders of Sandinista Revolution, led Nicaragua's liberation struggle. He proposed "revolutionary dictatorship" theory in leading the revolution, exemplified Sandinista alienation. His rule period, Nicaragua achieved transition from dictatorship to revolution, but also faced continuous US intervention and domestic political cycle.
